summary_1line: Kunti explains she urged her sons to reclaim honor and avenge Draupadi, but now renounces power and insists on retiring to the forest in penance.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kunti walks toward the forest while the Pandavas and their wives follow behind weeping, and she turns back to look at them with tearful resolve.
Draupadi and Subhadra, faces stricken with grief, follow Kunti as she departs the palace on her way to the wilderness.
Kunti stands before her sons recalling how Dussasana dragged Draupadi by the hair in the assembly hall, her voice fierce with remembered outrage.
